title: Fun add-on to a special event.. but, has limitations!!
text:
Fun add-on to a special event.. but, has limitations!!. Makes for a fun night or celebratory event.. but, lacking quality in structure to last a long time. At the right price point- there are always special events where this type item can kick up the fun and be a hit.. New Year, SuperBowl, Mardi Gras, Frat Nite, 21st bday, Spring break, retirement, bachelor party and so on!

Personally, we purchased to help our daughter celebrate and induct her thru the right of passage to the 21yr club!! Amongst partygoers (most being college age) this was a hit. No! This did not perform as we had intended- as it had ability to hold and fill shot glasses equally at once- BUT, carrying by the handle was NOT an option.. Doing so would’ve been disastrous. this is not stable enough to lift and carry once filled, contrary to description provided. If you see yourself walking around passing out shots like a gracious host... Think again!!!

Hold onto the tiny plugs included.. since shots aren’t always taken in increments of 6.. these can plug line and cut off liquid.. these performed well without leakage.

Set up was simple and straight forward and overall footprint is small..(about size of dinner plate circumference-) Note: spinner option on top.. is just a fun accessory. It allows you to make up a fun twist on the dispersing of the shots.. but, of course it’s optional.
Shot glasses are done in varied color and are a bit smaller in width vs. height. (an odd shape for most shot glasses) Made of a cheap acrylic plastic.. IF, these didn’t come in a set you would probably think they were disposable. NOTE: this CANNOT accommodate a standard shot glass- so, careful when clipping into position.. there are no replacements- and part of issue with this not being strong and long lasting.

This can be a lot of fun for an event.. but, it has limitations in carrying ability and longevity. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!
